purpose: Hypothetical few-shot behavior demonstrations; not evaluations or execution evidence.

expected_behavior: Verify and record the supplied reference hash without inventing a digest.
Preserve its style and original bytes while rerendering the new content.
Inspect table continuation and record the new output identity; do not reset to a generic template.

input.scenario: A hypothetical host can edit source content but has no available renderer or page viewer.

expected_behavior: Report the specific unavailable capabilities as host limitations.
Deliver only a clearly unrendered specification or source update.
Do not claim rendered-page inspection or design approval.
